max_jobs.description: Maximum number of queued jobs system-wide before lpd refuses new jobs.

printcap_path.description: Path to the printcap database file, which defines printer capabilities.

log_job.description: Whether to log job start/finish events to syslog (values: 'yes' or 'no').

hosts_allowed.description: Comma-separated list of hostnames/IPs allowed to submit print jobs. Leave blank to allow all (not recommended).

spool_root.description: Root directory for all printer spool directories.

conn_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to remote printers (0 = infinite).

write_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for writing job data to a printer (0 = infinite).

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed print jobs before aborting.

daemon_restart.description: Whether to auto-restart lpd on crash (values: 'yes' or 'no'). Rarely needed.

queues.description: List of printer queues to configure. Each queue defines a local or remote printer.

name.description: Queue identifier (must be unique). Used as the queue name in printcap entries.

description.description: Human-readable description of the queue (shown only in comments).

lpd_path.description: Device or device path (e.g., /dev/lpt0, /dev/usb/lp0, or 'network' for remote).

spool_dir.description: Per-queue spool directory for job files. Defaults to /var/spool/lpd/<queue_name>.

filter_path.description: Path to the filter program (e.g., to convert PostScript to printer language).

accounting_file.description: File path to record job accounting (size, user, time).

max_jobs.description: Maximum jobs for this queue (0 = use global max_jobs).

remote_host.description: Remote host for network printers (e.g., 'printer.example.com'). Leave blank for local.

remote_queue.description: Remote printer queue name (e.g., 'lp'). Required for network printers.
